title: Fetching without races
summary: Load data in an effect, show loading and error states, and ignore stale responses.
prompt: Finish `UserProfile`. Call `fetchUser(userId)` whenever `userId` changes. Show "Loading…" until it settles, then the user's name as a heading. On failure, show `role="alert"` with "Could not load user." If `userId` changes before an older request finishes, ignore the older result.
hints: Declare `let ignore = false` in the effect, check it before each `setState`, and set it to `true` in the cleanup.
Reset to the loading state at the start of every request.
